hyperedges.label: App distribution paths and their expiry limits

nodes.label: Fingerstick calibration of raw signal
nodes.rationale: Abbott's algorithm isn't public, so raw signal is calibrated by fingersticks; uncalibrated estimate is raw / 8.5.

nodes.label: Fire once per crossing, re-arm after recovery plus margin
nodes.norm_label: fire once per crossing, re-arm after recovery plus margin

nodes.label: Only the most severe crossed rule sounds
nodes.rationale: Avoids alarm storms when several rules cross at once; the rest are marked handled.
nodes.norm_label: only the most severe crossed rule sounds

nodes.label: Reports (TIR, GMI, SD, CV, AGP, PDF/CSV export)
nodes.norm_label: reports (tir, gmi, sd, cv, agp, pdf/csv export)

nodes.label: Missing data alert scheduled ahead
nodes.rationale: Scheduled in advance so it fires even if the app is killed.

nodes.label: Trend alerts (low soon 20-min projection, falling/rising fast)
nodes.norm_label: trend alerts (low soon 20-min projection, falling/rising fast)

nodes.label: Community reverse-engineered Libre protocol
nodes.rationale: Protocol follows community work and is verified only with synthetic data here.

nodes.label: Warn before removing last alert at or below 60 mg/dL
nodes.norm_label: warn before removing last alert at or below 60 mg/dl

nodes.label: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = false
nodes.rationale: Pre-answers export compliance so TestFlight builds don't wait on it.

nodes.label: Share raw sensor captures
nodes.rationale: Debug aid when pairing/decoding fails; contains sensor ID so must be kept private.

nodes.label: TestFlight distribution
nodes.rationale: Installs over the internet for family without a computer or sharing Apple ID; builds last 90 days.

nodes.label: Free Apple ID 7-day signing expiry
nodes.rationale: Free-account signatures expire after 7 days, so the app warns before expiry and must be re-signed; NFC entitlement unavailable so only the demo sensor works.

nodes.label: Not a medical device disclaimer
nodes.rationale: No regulatory clearance; secondary display only, always confirm with approved device and keep a backup.

nodes.label: Internal vs external testers
nodes.rationale: Internal testers get builds in minutes without review (recommended for family); external need Apple review (~1 day).

nodes.label: Trust Apple ID and enable Developer Mode
nodes.norm_label: trust apple id and enable developer mode

nodes.label: Sideloadly sideloading
nodes.rationale: Lets a Windows user install the unsigned CI IPA by re-signing with their Apple ID; needs non-Microsoft-Store iTunes and iCloud.

nodes.label: Ad-hoc sign with entitlements
nodes.rationale: Extensions signed first then app, ad-hoc, so Sideloadly re-signs with the user's Apple ID but keeps the entitlements.

nodes.label: Unsigned Release device build
nodes.rationale: CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO since CI has no certificates; signing happens later at sideload time.

nodes.label: GlucoseCore on Linux job
nodes.rationale: Runs swift test in swift:6.1 container on every push and PR.

nodes.label: MainActor.assumeIsolated in delegate callbacks
nodes.rationale: App code is Swift 5 mode; delegate callbacks calling @MainActor code must use MainActor.assumeIsolated.

nodes.label: Separate fix-forward commits
nodes.rationale: Fixes are pushed as separate commits so every step is visible on GitHub.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions as the only compiler
nodes.rationale: The Windows dev PC has no Swift toolchain, so every change is verified by pushing and reading CI runs.
nodes.norm_label: github actions as the only compiler

nodes.label: GlucoseCore Linux portability constraint
nodes.rationale: Linux Foundation lacks Apple APIs; GlucoseCore must avoid UIKit, CoreBluetooth, CoreNFC, CryptoKit and os so swift test runs on Linux.

nodes.label: Never commit .xcodeproj
nodes.rationale: Xcode project is generated from App/project.yml by XcodeGen, so committing it would create drift.

nodes.label: App group group.com.leonidasantoniadis.glucoseapp
nodes.rationale: Shared container lets the widget/Live Activity read data written by the app.

nodes.label: Widgets and Live Activity with Dynamic Island
nodes.norm_label: widgets and live activity with dynamic island

nodes.label: Local-only, no cloud data
nodes.rationale: All data stays on the phone, excluded from iCloud backup; optional Face ID lock and password-encrypted backup.

nodes.label: NFC readersession TAG entitlement
nodes.community_name: Paid Developer Program required for NFC

nodes.label: Demo simulated sensor (real time or 60x)
nodes.community_name: Paid Developer Program required for NFC

nodes.label: NFC pairing (sensor takeover from LibreLink)
nodes.rationale: Pairing over NFC takes over a sensor started with LibreLink; LibreLink alarms stop for it.
nodes.community_name: Paid Developer Program required for NFC

nodes.label: Paid Developer Program required for NFC
nodes.rationale: NFC sensor pairing entitlement requires the paid Apple Developer Program; free accounts can only run the demo sensor.
nodes.community_name: Paid Developer Program required for NFC
nodes.norm_label: paid developer program required for nfc

nodes.label: Glucose Trend Curve with Current Reading Dot
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the app's glucose graph, where the line ends in a marker for the latest sensor reading
nodes.norm_label: glucose trend curve with current reading dot

nodes.label: Glucose App Icon
nodes.rationale: 1024x1024 iOS app icon: white drop on a teal-to-blue diagonal gradient, with a glucose trend curve ending in a current-reading dot, signalling blood glucose monitoring at a glance

nodes.label: bluetooth-central background mode
nodes.rationale: Keeps the BLE stream alive while the app is backgrounded.

nodes.label: Keep app running in background
nodes.rationale: iOS relaunches for the sensor, but alerts are most reliable while the app is still alive in the background.
